caption: The drawing depicts a single figure standing in the center of a plain, light-colored background. The person has straight, dark hair parted in the middle and is wearing a checked blouse and skirt with a pattern of alternating light tan and reddish-brown squares. Over the skirt, the figure wears an apron in a muted salmon pink color, embroidered with a decorative border and featuring two rectangular pockets. The figure’s shoes are red and they stand with one foot slightly in front of the other. The artist’s signature, “David S. DeVault,” is written in small script in the lower right corner of the image. The drawing uses muted earth tones and the composition is symmetric, with the subject facing forward.
title: Doll
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
